journey.name: Edit: Colour group round trip
journey.action: Tap "Edit" on Home. When the system asks for photo access, choose "Allow all".
Tap a photo in "Edit: choose a photo".
journey.check: The Edit tool row shows Crop, Rotate, Adjust, Colour, Filters and Compare without swiping; "Colour" sits under a palette icon.
The row shows Back at the left, then RGB, HSL, Curves, and Compare at the right; no tool sheet is open.
journey.action: Tap HSL, choose the Saturation chip, drag the slider to the right.
journey.check: The slider value is no longer 0 and HSL shows its small "changed" dot.
journey.verify: The HSL sheet is closed, the first row is back, and Colour shows the "changed" dot.
The photo shows the original, every tool entry is disabled and only Compare is enabled. Tap Compare again to turn it off.
A dialog asks "Discard your changes?" with Discard and Keep editing. Tap Keep editing.
"Your photo is saved in Pictures/Kanso." shows; the saved photo carries the saturation change.
